Replay

Replay Godot storage

2 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓

Import this package when a game needs native files, browser persistence, local profiles, or an explicit recording-file chooser:

Odin
import storagegd "godot:replay/godot/storage"

It depends on Godot and Replay's engine-free codecs and value types. It does not open a gameplay transport, select session authority, or drive a simulation.

Task Public operations
Bounded native files storage_write, storage_read
Native authority checkpoints checkpoint_write, checkpoint_read
Checkpoints with immutable asset dependencies checkpoint_bundle_write, checkpoint_bundle_read, checkpoint_bundle_encode, checkpoint_bundle_decode
Native reconnect credential session_profile; session_token creates an explicit token without persisting it
Browser key/value transactions Browser_Store_Op, browser_store_read/write, browser_store_poll, browser_store_bytes, browser_store_close
Browser reconnect credential Browser_Identity, browser_identity_open, browser_identity_frame, browser_identity_token, browser_identity_close
Persistent display name Name_Profile, name_profile_open, name_profile_set, name_profile_frame, name_profile_close
Explicit recording-file selection File_Import, file_import_init, file_import_begin, file_import_poll, file_import_take, file_import_destroy

storage_read and successful bundle reads return owned bytes. Release them with the allocator supplied to the read; bundle views borrow those bytes. Native writes stage a complete file before renaming it over the destination. Keep one writer per path; this is not a portable power-loss guarantee.

Browser operations are asynchronous. Keep each owner at a stable address, pump it until completion, inspect its error/receipt, then close it. Submission does not mean a write committed. browser_store_write uses the previously observed revision for compare-and-swap; closing an outstanding operation discards its receipt and does not prove the transaction rolled back. Native/browser profile namespaces share the validation exposed by browser_store_key_valid.

File_Import owns its dialog and callbacks while its parent node remains alive. Read only after explicit user selection. file_import_take transfers the returned bytes to the caller; free them with the importer's allocator. Reset cancels the current selection/read, and destroy closes the complete owner.

The root replay/godot package keeps Browser_Checkpoint and its Session-specific save/restore policy. It builds on this package, as do enrollment and Room flows. See browser storage and local Session checkpoints for their detailed contracts.
